svg.title: Shared DTH Roles and Actors — DTH-PHC overlay on the DPI-H reference architecture

text.style: font:700 17px Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;fill:#fff
font:italic 10px Inter, "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;fill:#c9d6e6

svg.text: Drawn from the ArchiMate model “DTH-PHC overlay on the DPI-H reference architecture”

g.text: Colour: which part of the architecture a box belongs to
Why: who cares (stakeholders), and the drivers, goals, outcomes, values and requirements
Business: people, roles and organisations, the processes they carry out and the information they use
Shape: what kind of thing a box is (its small italic label names the exact kind)
Cut corners: a reason or aim, such as a stakeholder, goal, outcome or value
Square corners: something that exists, such as a system, a role, or a piece of data
Line: how two boxes are related, read from where the line starts to where it ends
Serving: serves (provides what the end needs)
Assignment: is assigned to, or carries out
Aggregation: groups (the end is a part that can also exist on its own)
Association: is related to (no more specific meaning)
